correctness.rationale: Exact periodic signed-derivative coupling reduces all real BV inputs to single arcs with variation two. Fourier/Parseval gives the finite-time norm formula. Uniform Riemann sums and summation-by-parts control all length scales. The cutoff cosine-transform expansion has a negative stable tail for every 1<alpha<2. The uniform two-power expansion near alpha=1 and exclusion of escaping minimizing scales yield the epsilon² coefficient pi/8 and unique rescaled optimizer 2/pi. All quantifiers, endpoint conventions and sequential limits are stated. The bundled checker passed 39 finite cross-checks; it does not replace the analytical argument.
